answer:
Your records show two medicines as current:

1. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily. It is for cholesterol.
2. Jardiance (empagliflozin) 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning. It is for diabetes.

Metformin 500 mg is recorded as finished, ended in April 2024, so it is not on your current list.

The records were last updated in mid-October 2026, so if anything has changed since then, such as a dose change or a new medicine, your doctor or pharmacist will have the up-to-date list. Please check this with them before you change anything.
